I am an old woman, 62 years, and I farm this small rice plot near Kilimanjaro alone with my family. I have no money for chemical fertilizer or improved seed, so I will use the seed I saved from last season and put some manure from my few animals on the field. The rice grows in the lowland where water collects in the rains, so I do not need to irrigate myself. My children help me weed and harvest, but my back is not strong, so for transplanting and harvest I must hire a few people to help.
